scripts.check:fast: cd src-tauri && cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo clippy --release --all-targets -- -D warnings && ! grep -rl --include='*.rs' 'unsafe_code' src | grep -v '^src/macos/' && ! grep -rnE --include='*.rs' -A1 '#!?\[cfg\(test\)\]' src | grep -vE '#\[cfg\(test\)\]$|-[[:space:]]*mod tests \{$|^--$' && ! grep -rn --include='*.rs' 'include!(' src && ! find src -name tests.rs -o -path '*/tests/*' | grep . && cd .. && ! grep -rnE '@ts-(ignore|expect-error)' src && tsc --noEmit
scripts.check:web: pnpm test && pnpm build && test -d dist && ! grep -rqE 'debug-dock-item|VITE_DOCKMOSS' dist
scripts.check:deps: cd src-tauri && cargo deny check advisories licenses && cd .. && pnpm audit --audit-level high
scripts.check:secrets: gitleaks git --redact --no-banner && gitleaks git --pre-commit --redact --no-banner && gitleaks git --pre-commit --staged --redact --no-banner
scripts.check:task: pnpm check:fast && pnpm check:web && pnpm check:rust-test && pnpm check:deps && pnpm check:secrets
